prompts.walk: Correct the WALK animation in this existing transparent sprite sheet. Preserve the EXACT wolf-cloak HUMAN male ranger character, clothing, bow, detailed sprite style, 4 columns x3 rows and true transparent alpha. Current four columns are too similar: redraw the LEGS and swinging arms as a genuine four-step alternating walking cycle. COLUMN 1 CONTACT: left leg extended forward and right leg stretched behind. COLUMN 2 PASSING: feet CLOSE TOGETHER beneath the pelvis, right knee lifting, torso slightly taller. COLUMN 3 OPPOSITE CONTACT: right leg extended forward and left leg stretched behind (OPPOSITE of column 1, visibly different shin position). COLUMN 4 OPPOSITE PASSING: feet CLOSE TOGETHER beneath pelvis with left knee lifting. Frame 1 and 3 have a WIDE stride, frame 2 and 4 have a NARROW stance. This wide/narrow/wide/narrow alternation is ESSENTIAL; do not repeat the same wide stride four times. Top row walking toward viewer/down, middle row walking RIGHT, bottom row walking away/up and showing back only. Shoulder/cape/head direction constant through each row. Feet at common ground baseline, no vertical floating, full body and bow all inside cells with generous margins. No text, grids, ground or shadows. 1536x1024 sheet, 12 figures exactly.
prompts.attack: Edit this animation sheet, preserving all twelve sprites, their layout, transparent alpha, detailed pixel RPG style, costume and scale. Change ONLY the TOP ROW's shoot direction. Top-row archer is FRONT-facing looking TOWARD VIEWER/downscreen, his human face and chest visible. In top row columns 2 and 3, he must aim the bow DOWNWARD TOWARD THE VIEWER, a foreshortened arrow points toward the bottom edge of the image; the bow arm extends diagonally down and forward, NOT horizontally right. Column 2 fully drawn arrow, column 3 released arrow with empty bowstring and drawing hand recoiled, column 1 and 4 relaxed lowered bow. Keep the middle row RIGHT-facing and bottom row BACK-facing as shown. In bottom row keep arrow shooting upscreen away from viewer. All figures fully inside their own equal grid cells, feet baseline consistent. No text, grid, ground or shadows. True transparent background, no checkerboard. Full sheet 4 columns x3 rows.
prompts.cast: Using image 1 as the character identity reference, REDRAW ONLY the spellcasting animation as a strict 2-column, 3-row sheet of SIX separate whole-body sprites. Wolf-pelt human male ranger with brown leather, gray fur cloak, skull shoulder and belt, quiver and metal shin guards; same detailed 2D game sprite style and costume. This action is NOT bow shooting. His wooden bow is safely SLUNG DIAGONALLY ACROSS HIS BACK throughout, both hands EMPTY, no arrows in hands, no bowstring aiming. First column: hands together at chest gathering a small blue orb. Second column: both empty hands spread outward casting two compact blue/green magical orbs. Clearly different arm positions, SAME feet placement and constant model scale. Top row FRONT, face/chest visible looking downscreen. Middle row true right SIDE, looking right. Bottom row true BACK, turned fully away facing upscreen, quiver/wolf cloak/bow visible, no face/chest. Each character occupies its own equal 512x512 cell in a 1024x1536 sheet with ample margins. FULL body no overlap. No projectile, words, labels, grid, shadow, ground, title or scene. True transparent ALPHA background, not a picture of transparency. Green/blue magical edges translucent. Preserve character identity rather than making a new costume.
prompts.hit: Create a corrected HURT REACTION sprite sheet of the wolf-cloak human male archer from the reference portrait. Six figures in exactly 2 columns and 3 rows. Detailed old-school 2D RPG sprite. Keep gray wolf-head hood, rugged HUMAN face, gray fur cape, brown leather and metal shin guards, skull shoulder and skull belt, quiver, wooden bow. All sprites hold the bow LOWERED near waist in left hand; bowstring slack, NEVER aiming, NEVER pulling string, no nocked arrow. Column 1: struck, torso leaning back, empty right hand raised defensively near chest. Column 2: partial recovery, torso upright, empty right hand lowers to waist, still not shooting. Feet in nearly identical positions, identical character proportions and scale. Row 1 FRONT facing viewer, chest visible. Row 2 RIGHT PROFILE facing right. Row 3 strictly BACK, facing away from viewer, cloak and quiver visible in BOTH frames, never face or chest. Transparent alpha background, no checkerboard, no glow, text, lines, shadow or ground. 1024x1536 portrait canvas of equal 512x512 cells with generous clear margins; every figure entirely inside its own cell.
